svg.text: One Docker image per commit travels unchanged from CI to production. Rollback is flipping the proxy back to the previous colour.
Build, unit tests, lint, dependency scan,
Tag with git sha, sign it
Flyway migration on a copy of data shape
Not at month end or evening peak
Alert fired? Flip the proxy back to blue (seconds). Database stays compatible because migrations
are expand-first; contract steps ship one release later.
Internal testing, closed test with the pilot group, then production at 5%, 20%, 50%, 100%. Feature flags can switch features off
Static build to the admin host behind VPN. Same CI, versioned with admin-v tags, previous build kept for instant rollback.
Part 10 · System diagrams · Mulungushi University, Zambia
